ActorTalk: Ah, the Gray Raven Commandant!
It really is you! I'm a big fan! What brings you to F.O.S. today? Are you guest lecturing, or here on a mission?
Just looking around.
It's classified.
Just looking around? But the classes are not running right now... not much to see.
A classified mission? Wow... you can count on me, my lips are sealed!
And the person with you... she's not a Gray Raven member, is she? Wait, she looks... familiar somehow.
She's my new team member!
She's a new instructor!
Right?
...Yes. I'm a new recruit.
She looks like an attacker, too. Wouldn't that make four attackers in Gray Raven? I'm surprised Command would greenlight a squad composition like that.
...The Task Force uses whatever works to complete the objective. That's all that matters.
S-so, can I ask the question nobody else dares to?!
What?
With her on the team, who's the strongest member of Gray Raven now?
Every member is strong in their own way.
If I had to guess... probably her.
A vague answer like that just fuels speculation... Fine. It's me. I'm the strongest. Satisfied?
Hmph.
I see! You do carry that kind of aura. But, uh... wait, I really feel like I've seen you before... maybe in a tactical bulletin...
You. That's enough questions.
...Right! Sorry, I've asked more than enough!
Wow, really? A new instructor? What subject do you teach?
What subject...
...Target Neutralization. It should be obvious.
Oh, right! I haven't seen it in the course catalog, but... I get it now! So the handcuffs are for the class, not for some... other reason.
Hey.
It's part of the standard curriculum.
Sorry, sorry! I just say whatever I'm thinking. It's just... those things on your wrists are hard to miss.
They're training restraints. We're conducting a field simulation.
Now I'm really interested, Instructor! Could I get a preview of the course material? Like... how you'd actually subdue 【kuroname】?
Should we demonstrate...?
Hardly necessary. With or without these on, I could take down 【kuroname】 anytime I wanted.
I see! You do carry that kind of aura. But, uh... wait, I really feel like I've seen you before... maybe in a tactical bulletin...
You. That's enough questions.
...Uh, ah, right! Y-yes! I've asked plenty!
You scared him off with just a look.
You didn't traumatize that student, did you?
I don't plan on spending all day being stopped in hallways. The nuisance is dealt with. Move.
And your cover stories were pathetic.
